pr_target: dev (no PR — commit direct per AIPLA workflow)

features.description: useTeacherAuth hook — Firebase Auth state subscription + redirect to sign-in when missing. Reads from existing firebase.ts setup.
acceptance_criteria: Hook returns {user, loading, error}
Subscribes to Firebase auth state changes via onAuthStateChanged
Unauthed user with no in-flight auth → returns user=null, triggers redirect to /teacher/sign-in
Already-authed user → returns user immediately on mount

features.description: /teacher/sign-in page — Google OAuth button → signInWithRedirect → redirects to /teacher/classes on success.
acceptance_criteria: Page renders a Google sign-in button (lucide-react icon, no emoji)
Click triggers signInWithRedirect(auth, new GoogleAuthProvider())
On successful redirect-return, lands at /teacher/classes
Error handling for popup-blocked / network-failure with retry
features.notes: Document Firebase console OAuth redirect URI prerequisite in the M2 commit message.

features.description: AuthContext extension — surface Firebase teacher token alongside (not instead of) anon-group state. fetchWithAuth picks the right one per route.
acceptance_criteria: AuthContext exposes both firebaseUser and groupAuth state
fetchWithAuth attaches Firebase token to /api/classes/* and /api/teacher/* paths
fetchWithAuth keeps attaching group JWT to /api/skills/*, /api/sessions/*, /api/chat-stream (existing student paths)
Existing /group + /chat/* flows unaffected (regression tests)

features.description: Route guard wiring — /teacher/* layout uses useTeacherAuth; unauthed → redirect to /teacher/sign-in. LOCAL_MODE stub remains for dev.
acceptance_criteria: /teacher/classes unauthed → redirects to /teacher/sign-in
/teacher/classes/<id> unauthed → redirects to /teacher/sign-in (preserves return path)
LOCAL_MODE: workshop-user stub still works for /teacher/* (is_teacher=true per 1.A M3)
Production: unauthed user cannot view any /teacher/* page
features.notes: If a layout.tsx already exists for /teacher, modify rather than create.

features.description: Multi-class filter dropdown on /teacher/reports + /teacher/analytics. Lets the teacher narrow report data to one class.
acceptance_criteria: Reports page: dropdown lists all teacher's classes; selecting one filters sessions to that class's group codes
Analytics page: same dropdown; chat skill receives class context in its prompt
Sticky selection across navigation (localStorage)
Default: 'All classes' selected on first load

features.description: analytics-chat skill template (teacher-only via role:teacher tag from 1.A M8).
acceptance_criteria: backend/skills/templates/analytics-chat/SKILL.md exists with accessControl tagged [role:teacher]
After re-seed, GET /api/skills as teacher includes analytics-chat
GET /api/skills as anon-group student excludes analytics-chat
Skill prompt scaffolds the teacher Q&A flow (3+ suggested-question patterns)
features.notes: M6 has no dependency on M1-M5; could parallelize.

features.description: Student-side opt-in share toggle on session end + teacher report flag display. Default off; dismissible.
acceptance_criteria: Student session-end shows a small 'Send summary to teacher?' toggle (default off)
Flipping it POSTs to backend; ChatSessionIndex carries the optInShared flag
Teacher report card shows a 'student opted in' badge when the flag is true
Toggle dismissible; doesn't block session end

features.description: CLI smoke — aiplatform class new/list/get/lessons/groups/delete round-trips against deployed dev with real Firebase auth.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/smoke-v1-teacher-cli.sh runs the full lifecycle (create → list → lessons → mint group → delete)
Exits 0 on success
Documents the aiplatform auth login step required for Firebase token acquisition

features.description: Quality gates + direct-to-dev merge. Backend make test-fast + frontend npm run quality:check both green, no emoji, FF-merge to dev.
acceptance_criteria: cd backend && make test-fast green (no regression)
cd frontend && npm run quality:check green
No emoji introduced in any sprint-touched file
Branch rebased onto origin/dev and FF-merged
origin/dev pushed

queue_rationale: Consumes 1.A backend (Class entity + is_teacher gate, both shipped). Runs AFTER the 3 June Phase 2 demo since Phase 2 already works on LOCAL_MODE. Bigger sprint (~2-2.5d). M6 (analytics-chat skill) is parallelizable with M1-M5.
